name: password-reset-email-confirmation
subject: Your password has been changed
previewText: Please use your new password to log in to your Abundance account

fields.heading: Your password has been reset
fields.body:
Hello {user_first_name},

The password for your Abundance account has been updated. Please use your new password to login.

If you did not make this change, please contact us immediately at support@abundanceinvestment.com or 020 3475 8666 so that we can ensure the safety of your account.
